personality: Fusion: 6 Glass / Luxe structure and surfaces + 7 Dark-First Utility typography and metrics
personality_one_liner: A cinematic, premium command center that balances high-end gaming aesthetics with tactical, dark-first utility.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical breathing room for cinematic feel, tighter modular spacing for KPI metrics and utility rows.

do's: Use heavily on sticky headers, bottom tab bar, and modal scrims.
Use frosted glass overlays on top of the abstract purple gradient background for the Creator Dashboard hero section.
Ensure underlying tinted bases are ≥75% opacity to guarantee text readability.
Use glass for premium 'Tournament Bracket' active state containers.
dont's: Do not use glass for simple list items or form inputs.
Do not apply glass where underlying elements are entirely solid #0A0A0A (it just looks like a gray box).
Avoid stacking more than 2 blurred surfaces on one screen.

screens.name: Creator Dashboard
screens.purpose: A premium control center showing the creator's listed games, total revenue, sales KPIs, and Battle Pass tier.

states.loading: Skeleton grids with a subtle dark shimmer over #141414.
states.empty: Brand-tinted SVG illustration of a cosmic studio, inviting the user to generate their first game.
states.error: Readable text with off-white typography and a muted secondary Retry button.

screens.layout: Use a mobile-first stacked layout. Top: Cinematic glassmorphism hero showing Battle Pass Tier progress over an abstract neon background. Below hero: 2-column grid of KPI cards (Revenue, Sales, Plays). Below KPIs: A horizontal scrolling section or vertical list for 'Listed Games' with game cover images, titles, and live status badges.

screens.name: Live-Ops Battle Pass
screens.purpose: Visualizes the current season's rewards, XP progression, and available tier unlocks.

states.loading: Dark shimmer skeletons for the reward track.
states.empty: No active season message with a countdown to the next season.
states.error: Error loading season data with a Retry CTA.

screens.layout: Off-black background. A large vertical or horizontal scrolling track. Active/unlocked items use high-contrast desaturated colors. Locked items use dark gray (#262626) with low opacity. Progress bar uses a desaturated violet with a subtle glow, filling an off-black track. No pure white text.

screens.name: Tournament Bracket
screens.purpose: Displays single-elimination brackets, match-ups, and voting for AI generated games.

states.empty: Illustration indicating tournament registration is open.
states.error: Error loading bracket data with a Retry CTA.

screens.layout: Pan-and-zoom or horizontally scrolling tree layout. Matchup cards use surfaceSecondary with borderStrong. The 'active' match up glows with a brandPrimary 1px border. Focus heavily on dense, tactical typography (Rajdhani) for scores and game names to allow fast scanning.

game_cover_generic.alt: Glowing neon game controller icon floating above dark foliage

instructions_to_main_agent: Apply a Fusion personality: Mix the premium, cinematic depth of Glass / Luxe (Personality 6) with the tactical, information-dense typography of Dark-First Utility (Personality 7).
Use Rajdhani for all headings, scores, KPI values, and bracket metrics. Use Satoshi for labels, body text, and metadata to maintain readability.
Do NOT use pure black (#000000). Use the defined #0A0A0A for the main background to avoid OLED smearing and harsh contrast fatigue.

For the Creator Dashboard: Place the `dashboard_hero_bg` behind the top section. Overlay a vertical linear gradient (transparent to #0A0A0A at the bottom) over the image so it fades into the rest of the screen. Place the Battle Pass Tier progress and high-level creator stats inside a glassmorphism container on top of this.

For the Live-Ops Battle Pass: Make the UI feel athletic and durable. The progress line should use the brand color with an off-black unfilled track. Avoid heavy drop shadows; use border highlights (#404040) or subtle surface lightening to indicate elevation.
For Tournaments: Use compact `surfaceSecondary` cards for the bracket nodes. The currently active/voting match should have a 1pt `brandPrimary` border to draw the eye immediately.
Always apply haptic feedback (using expo-haptics) to all key interactions: voting, claiming rewards, tab changes, and publishing games.
Use Phosphor icons consistently. Ensure they are all the same weight (either all 'regular' or all 'fill').
Preserve existing functionality and testIDs. You are elevating the design system, not tearing down the core logic.
